# Endpoints

All paths are relative to the site root (e.g. `https://<owner>.github.io/extracurricular-api/`).
Every endpoint is a static JSON file, so there are no query strings, keys or rate limits.

| Name | Path | Returns | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schools` | `v1/schools.json` | the schools this API covers |  |
| `info` | `v1/{school}/info.json` | faculties and subfaculties, data sources and freshness, every valid filter value with counts | `v1/queens/info.json` |
| `all` | `v1/{school}/all.json` | every activity at the school | `v1/queens/all.json` |
| `item` | `v1/{school}/item/{id}.json` | one activity, by id | `v1/queens/item/engsoc-qset.json` |
| `filter` | `v1/{school}/filter/fac-{faculty}/sub-{subfaculty}/type-{type}/app-{app}/first-{first}.json` | activities matching all five filters; use -any to skip one | `v1/queens/filter/fac-engineering/sub-any/type-design-team/app-open/first-friendly.json` |
| `tags` | `v1/{school}/tags.json` | every tag, with how many activities have it | `v1/queens/tags.json` |
| `tag` | `v1/{school}/tag/{tag}.json` | activities with one tag | `v1/queens/tag/robotics.json` |
| `index` | `v1/index.json` | this list, as JSON | `v1/index.json` |
| `versions` | `versions.json` | every API version and which is current. Never moves between versions | `versions.json` |

`{school}` is a school id from `v1/schools.json`. `{id}` is an activity's `id`. `{tag}`
is any tag in `tags.json`.

## Filter URLs

```
v1/{school}/filter/fac-{faculty}/sub-{subfaculty}/type-{type}/app-{app}/first-{first}.json
```

All five segments are required, in this order. Each starts with the name of what it filters,
and `-any` turns that filter off. Every value is listed in [filters.md](filters.md).

## Errors

A path that doesn't exist (a typo, an unknown id, an invalid filter value, or a `sub-` value under
the wrong faculty) returns **HTTP 404**. Static hosting can't return JSON errors, so check the
status code before parsing.

## Response format

Every response is a JSON object wrapped in the same envelope: see [responses.md](responses.md).
